purpose: Fingerprints and structural classification of official textbook files pulled from the portal. The PDFs themselves are deliberately NOT committed and NOT shipped: they are source material for preparing original lessons, not distributable assets.
method: tools/inspect-pdf.ps1 — counts /BaseFont, /ToUnicode, /Subtype /Image and DCTDecode markers in the raw PDF objects.

conclusion: Every inspected official PDF (three files across grades 7) is a page-image scan. Producing lesson text therefore requires OCR with Persian support. No Persian OCR engine is available in the current build environment: the bundled Python and Node runtimes do not execute, Windows OCR only ships an English recognizer, and installing a Persian recognizer or Tesseract is a system-level change that needs the owner's approval. Authoring lessons from memory instead of the controlling source would violate the project's source policy, so no lesson content has been authored yet.
